bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 14 × 14 inches and small bags up to 5 × 8 × 1 inches are permitted. Oversized bags and backpacks are not.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There are nearby Arena District garages; parking can be reserved online through the Arena District or Park Columbus.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue directions and operator FAQ do not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold onsite; outside food and drinks are prohibited. Some shows have pre-show food and drink specials at the adjoining A&R Music Bar or Basement.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: For general-admission concerts, ask Guest Services on arrival for an accessible seating arrangement. Contact the venue in advance about sign language interpretation.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Almost all shows prohibit leaving and re-entering; confirm any show-specific exception before exiting.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call opens about two hours before doors at the KEMBA Live! box office. Regular hours are Tuesday–Friday, 11 a.m.–6 p.m., and noon–9 p.m. on show days.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The time on your ticket is the door-opening time; the music usually starts about an hour later. Most shows are general admission.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
